## New in this release

RQ MOD 2.67.0 follows 2.65.1 and brings 2.65.2 to 2.66.2 with it (none of them was released on its own). Most of it is the game's look: the 3D drawn at the window's own size, the game's own 3D settings that the engine kept without using (anti-aliasing, texture filtering, shadows), a sharp window on a scaled monitor, and every magnification filter in Config. For mods, skill forms.

### For players

- **The 3D at the window's size** (2.67.0): in a window larger than 1024 by 768, in full screen, or on a monitor that Windows scales above 100%, a fight's monsters and a quest's map are drawn at the window's own pixels, as sharp as the window allows, while the menus, cards and text are enlarged by the filter as before. On by default: "3D at the window's size" on Config's Other 2, under the filters, and in the title bar's menu.
- **The game's 3D settings work** (Config's 3D tab):
  - **Anti-Aliasing** 2X, 4X or 8X smooths the edges of the models and of the fight backgrounds (2.65.3), and of leaves, grass and hair cut out of their pictures (2.66.2).
  - **Texture Filtering** up to 16X anisotropic keeps the floors sharp into the distance (2.66.1).
  - **Shadows** and **Shadow Map Resolution** set how soft a shadow's edge is and how closely it follows its model (2.66.2).
- **A new player's first settings** (2.66.2): the highest 3D settings with 16X filtering, and the Lanczos filter for a larger window. Settings already saved stay as they are.
- **A sharp window on a scaled monitor** (2.66.1): at 125% (common on laptops) Windows stretched the game's window and blurred everything; the game is now drawn into the screen's own pixels.
- **All five magnification filters on Config's Other 2** (2.65.2): Standard, Bicubic, Nearest, Lanczos and xBRZ, each with a tip; the title bar's menu marks the one in use.

Guide: [Install, "A larger window" and "Smoother 3D"](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/install).

### The programs, and what is new in them

- **[Rance Browser 1.4.0](https://github.com/RQ-Modding/rance-browser/releases/tag/v1.4.0)** (`xsystem4\rance-browser.exe`; 1.3.0 in RQ MOD 2.65.1): Sengoku Rance, Rance 01, Rance 02 and Rance 03 are tested, each with English labels for its CG groups; the newer games' archives are read by their folders, Rance 03's music is found in its sound archive with each track's loop, and voices have a tab of their own. Guide: [Looking through the game's files](https://rq-modding.github.io/rq-modding-docs/guide/file-browser).
- **[RQ Scene Editor 1.0.1](https://github.com/RQ-Modding/rq-scene-editor/releases/tag/v1.0.1)** (`xsystem4\rq-scene-editor.exe`), as in 2.65.1, built on Rance Browser 1.4.0's library.

### For mods

- **Skill forms** (2.66.0): `rq.skill.form_of` declares skills that take each other's place in one skill row, as the game turns Melee Attack into Thrust Attack, keeping the row's uses and its hotbar place; the buy list sells the form a character holds, and `rq.chara.learnable`, `price` and `learn` follow the game's recalculation.
- **The window** (2.67.0): `rq.ui.window()` (its size, the game's picture in it, the 3D's state), `rq.ui.set_window_size`, and `rq.ui.shot(path, { window = true })` for the window as shown.
- Updated mods for skill forms, which need this release: [Loadouts 1.4.0](https://github.com/RQ-Modding/loadouts/releases/tag/v1.4.0) (a loadout follows a row through its forms, so Magic Thrust builds load), [Spellblade Knowledge 1.3.0](https://github.com/RQ-Modding/spellblade-knowledge/releases/tag/v1.3.0) and [Athena QoL 1.1.0](https://github.com/RQ-Modding/athena-qol/releases/tag/v1.1.0).
